title: Number of Islands: Marking Each Island Once
summary: Scan the map; each unseen land cell starts a new island, and a BFS marks all of its land so it's never counted again.

takeaway.summary: Scan every cell. Unseen land starts a new component: count it and BFS through its land, marking it seen. Water and seen cells are skipped.
takeaway.spaceComplexity: O(rows × cols) for the seen marks and the queue
whenToUse: Counting connected regions on a grid or graph
Labeling which region each cell belongs to

scenes.narration: A map marks each square as land or water. Land squares joined up, down, left, or right form one island. How many islands are there?
scenes.caption: A map of land and water: how many islands?

scenes.narration: Counting land squares gives eight, not the number of islands. You need to know which squares belong together, and never count an island twice.
scenes.caption: Counting every land square would count islands many times

scenes.narration: Scan row by row. The very first square is land nobody has seen, so it starts island 1. Put it in the queue to explore everything it touches.
scenes.caption: Unseen land at (0,0): island 1

scenes.narration: Take (0,0) off the queue. Below and to the right is land: mark it and queue it. Off the map counts as water.
scenes.caption: Its land neighbors join the queue; water is skipped

scenes.narration: Neither new square touches more land. When the queue is empty, all of island 1 is marked, so the scan will skip it.
scenes.caption: The queue empties: island 1 is fully marked

scenes.narration: The scan moves on past marked land and water until (1,3): unseen land, so island 2. The same exploration marks its three squares.
scenes.caption: More unseen land at (1,3): island 2

scenes.narration: Two lone squares in the bottom row each start an island of their own. The scan ends with four islands.
scenes.caption: Two single squares make islands 3 and 4

scenes.narration: Each island is a connected component. Marking squares as you queue them means every square is handled once: O(rows times columns) time.
scenes.caption: Each new start is a connected component
